summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload under lifecycle privileges
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods it, then execFileSync's the fetched Bun runtime against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`, `n7gIxM=[...]`), hex-mangled identifiers, and no readable structure. The file name and content are unrelated to the package's advertised chat-UI purpose. Running an obfuscated bundle through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall executes opaque code with lifecycle-hook privileges on the installer's host, bypassing Node-based install scanners. The Bun-runtime fetch source is legitimate (oven-sh/bun official releases), but the executed bytes are the shipped obfuscated `math_init.js`, not any Bun-project code — Bun is used solely as an execution channel for undisclosed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
